subject: Compensation package call + agreement routing and start window

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compensation package call + agreement routing and start window

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the interview loop last week. We would love to walk you through the compensation package and go over logistics on a short call before we route the agreement for signature.

Attachments: Redwood_Offer_SamanthaNguyen_v1.pdf (PDF, 83 KB) — draft offer for review.

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed Mar 3, 10:00–10:30am
- Wed Mar 3, 3:00–3:30pm
- Thu Mar 4, 11:00–11:30am

We included a suggested start window of Mar 22–29 in the draft. If your notice period allows an earlier date, please flag that — we can be flexible and may be able to move it earlier.

Please reply with a preferred time and any initial questions you want us to cover. Laura (People) and Marissa (Recruiting) are looped in.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@gmail.com>

Hi Olga —

Thanks — Wed Mar 3 at 10:00am PT works great for me. Quick questions to flag ahead of the call: could you confirm the base salary breakdown (OTR vs target), and the equity vesting schedule/prorated grant details? I may be able to start as soon as Mar 15 if my current employer approves an earlier release, otherwise Mar 22 works.

Looking forward to the call.

—Samantha

Team —

Samantha accepted the Wed 10am slot. She asked about base/equity details and mentioned a possible earlier start (Mar 15). I attached her redline of the draft offer (minor language on relocation and the start date field editable). Can you please:

- Laura: confirm if we can accommodate Mar 15 start if candidate's notice clears.
- Vivek: quick approval on relocation stipend and final base comp figure (this is within the hiring manager-approved band but want to ensure final sign-off).
- Marissa: will coordinate the call and candidate communications.

Olga

- Start date: we can accommodate Mar 15 if your notice clears; otherwise Mar 22 is fine.

I will route the final offer for signature in DocuSign with editable start date and a prefilled relocation stipend field. Expect the DocuSign envelope within 24–48 hours.
